# Third-Party Attribution: Venn & Sets Lab

## Project: venn-shader
- **Upstream Repository**: https://github.com/galloppinggryphon/venn-shader
- **Author**: galloppinggryphon
- **License**: MIT License

### Notice
This feature incorporates concepts and inspiration for interactive 2-set and 3-set Venn diagram region shading based on the open-source project referenced above. All implementations in BoolStudio (SVG rendering, Boolean AST adapter, Principle of Inclusion-Exclusion calculations, and state management) were authored independently to integrate natively with BoolStudio's architecture.
